admission.justification: Outline, badges, views, traversal and filter only together make the tree navigable: an outline without one-line rows is unreadable, badges without the Changed view hide changes, and traversal without kept rows loses the walk. No member alone delivers finding one's way.

guarantee: The reviewer's sidebar is a navigation tree over the comparison outline: one line per family and invariant with one change badge, the Changed view showing what the leaf changed with the whole catalogue one switch away, nothing behind a disclosure, rows selected/traversed/filtered without ever removing a walked row, and every text, reason and record living in the main page.
title: The reviewer's outline navigation tree
